notes: SHIP v1.14.374 - NO SILENT FAILURE ON BOOT ENTRY. Owner: fix the silent catch, ship it. The tap-to-enter handler wrapped its launch() call in catch(e){ softReset(); } - it swallowed the throw with no console.warn and no toast, then quietly restored the TAP TO ENTER text. A real entry failure was therefore INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A MISSED TAP. That cost a full live audit on 2026-08-03 (git history, live-vs-local byte compare, vm.Script on all four inline blocks, all 54 precache URLs HEAD-checked) before the cause turned out to be stale service-worker state on the device and not the code at all. Every one of those checks passed; the swallowed error is why there was nothing to read. FOUR LINES CHANGED, ONE HELPER ADDED, all inside the existing v1.14.64 tap-anywhere IIFE. (1) The bind guard if (!boot || !tap) return; now console.warns which of the two elements was missing before returning - it was the second silent failure on the same path. (2) New bootFail(e) helper: console.warn the real error, call the existing softReset() so the retry path stays live (softReset clears fired), then set the hint to ENTRY FAILED - RETRY. (3)+(4) Both catch sites now call bootFail(e) instead of softReset(). Also replaced throw 0 with throw new Error(launch() is not defined) at both sites - throw 0 logged nothing useful, which defeated the point of logging at all. WHY THE VISIBLE TEXT AND NOT JUST A LOG: there is no console in a cold aisle. A console.warn alone satisfies the letter of the No Silent Failures rule and helps nobody holding an iPhone at 2am. phantomToast was NOT used - the splash is a fixed full-screen layer and a toast under it is unverifiable - so the hint line itself carries the signal. ENTRY FAILED - RETRY is 20 characters; .pe-taphint is display:inline-block inside a text-align:center block with 26px side padding, so a long string wraps rather than overflowing - Rule 1 zero-horizontal-overflow holds even at 320px. BLAST RADIUS ACKNOWLEDGED: this is the app first interaction and a fault here bricks every entry, so the edit is deliberately minimal - no restructuring of fire(), no change to timings, the reduced-motion branch, the pe-dive/pe-flash sequence, launch() itself, or any CSS. NOT TOUCHED: launch() at L18110, the boot markup, the #boot stacking context, ?legacy=1. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge reads v1.14.374. (2) TAP TO ENTER still enters normally, both a cold launch and a relaunch - this is the only check that really matters, everything else is the failure path. (3) The hint should read ENTERING... during the dive exactly as before. (4) The new text only ever appears if entry actually fails; if you see ENTRY FAILED - RETRY in normal use, that is a REGRESSION - revert. (5) ?legacy=1 unchanged. ROLLBACK: revert this commit - restores the original catch, the guard and the stamps together.
